# openai

These skills are copied from https://github.com/openai/skills at commit
`49f948faa9258a0c61caceaf225e179651397431`, under the Apache-2.0 license.
Each skill's license is in its own `LICENSE.txt`.

RooAGI sets `license` and `source` in each SKILL.md frontmatter, renames a skill
to `openai-<name>` when another skill already has its name, and may append a
"RooAGI notes" section from `notes/openai/`; the rest is unchanged.
